svg.text: How far above the safe line India breathes
Yearly PM2.5, µg/m³. WHO guideline 5. India's own standard 40. (IQAir 2025, AQLI 2025)
Of every 6 deaths in India, 1 is linked to air pollution
1.67 million of 9.4 million deaths in 2019, 17.8% (Lancet Planetary Health 2021). Economic loss US$36.8 billion, 1.36% of GDP.
